primary_claim: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) trained on Qwen2.5-7B show some robustness to irrelevant additions in their Claude-generated initialization guesses (RL strips out an appended nonsense sentence and mostly strips out an injected sentiment within 100-200 iterations), but when initialized with entirely implausible statements the resulting NLA achieves nearly the same reconstruction accuracy (FVE 0.68 vs 0.70) as a plausible-initialized NLA while emitting 99.3% implausible claims, and RL actually decreases plausible-initialized NLA claim plausibility from 21% to 7.6% over training even as it slightly increases implausible-initialized NLA plausibility from 0.08% to 0.7%.

effect.metric: fraction of variance explained (FVE) and Claude-judged claim plausibility rate, plausible- vs implausible-initialized NLA
effect.value: control (plausible-init) NLA: FVE=0.70, plausibility drops from 21% (post-SFT) to 7.6% (post-RL); implausible-init NLA: FVE=0.68 (nearly matching), plausibility rises from 0.08% to 0.7% (post-RL), remaining far below the plausible-init NLA

depends_on: LessWrong: Some observations about NLA explanations
contradicts_or_qualifies: Qualifies Anthropic's NLA work (Fraser-Taliente et al. 2026) and Chalnev's independently-invented NLAs: replicates their finding that most NLA claims are implausible, and extends it by showing RL can make plausible-initialized NLA claims even more implausible over training, and that near-identical reconstruction accuracy can be achieved by an NLA that confabulates almost all of its explanations
stated_future_work: Replicate these results with a larger training dataset as well as a larger and more capable model
limitations_stated: Only experimented with one fairly small and dated LLM (Qwen2.5-7B) and a small training dataset (20k documents vs Anthropic's 100k), which likely explains the somewhat lower FVE (0.70) than Anthropic's 100k-document run (0.75)
Even the best NLAs trained here produce far fewer plausible guesses than Anthropic's Opus 4.6 NLA (64% theme-plausible, 28% entity-plausible, 24% detail-plausible)
quote: an implausible-initialized NLA can obtain similar reconstruction loss as a plausible-initialized NLA (FVE = 0.68 vs. 0.70) while remaining many times less plausible (0.7% vs 7.6%).
